active_ingredient: Zinc oxide 15.25%, with benzyl alcohol and hypoallergenic lanolin
usage: Apply a thin layer as required. For nappy rash, clean and dry the area and use a light covering after changes as needed.
warnings: For external use only; avoid eyes and mucous membranes.
Do not use with known hypersensitivity to any ingredient.
Product-contaminated fabrics burn more easily; keep away from naked flames and smoking.
Sodium benzoate may cause local irritation and may increase jaundice in newborn babies.
